# Marketing Loops

`aaj-marketing-loops` · v1.0.0 · Design · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/aaj-marketing-loops/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Does this channel compound, how much does the loop lower our effective CAC, and which stage should we fix first?

**Inputs:** The stages of one turn of the loop with their conversion rates, the output per completion (e.g. invites sent), and optionally a paid CAC and a paid feed rate for projection

**Output:** The loop factor k with a verdict, the amplification and effective-CAC it buys, the throttling stage to fix first, and a period-by-period projection decomposing loop-driven from paid-driven growth

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill aaj-marketing-loops`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/aaj-marketing-loops/resources/loop-model.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/aaj-marketing-loops/resources/loop-model.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- k is the product of every stage rate and the output per turn, so optimism compounds: rates padded at each stage multiply into a k the loop will not deliver. Use measured rates and label estimates as scenarios.
- The projection holds k constant and imposes no saturation ceiling. With k at or above 1 the curve runs away; trust its shape, not its final number. Real loops tend to slow as the network fills.
- Each projection period is one full turn of the loop. The engine does not know how long a turn takes, so map periods to your real cycle time before reading them as months.
- It assumes the last stage's output really re-enters as the first stage's input. It cannot tell a loop from a funnel with the ends joined; if nothing feeds back, the k it reports means nothing.

**Review before acting:** The growth lead confirms each stage rate comes from analytics, not estimates, before the effective CAC feeds a budget. Re-measure k as the network fills rather than assuming today's value holds at scale.
